summary: Tested new Fornitori feature: GET /api/suppliers/summary backend endpoint (12/12 pytest tests) and /fornitori frontend page. Backend logic is fully correct: aggregation, source split, whitespace trimming, zero/missing amount skipping, invalid source defaulting to conto_aziendale, 'Senza fornitore' sorted last, pending exclusion, month filter, preventivi included. Frontend page renders correctly with totals cards, month navigation (prev/next), empty state, expandable supplier rows, source badges, and hamburger/sidebar nav-fornitori link. Found and fixed a CRITICAL runtime crash when expanding supplier rows caused by variable shadowing.

ui_bugs.issue: Expanding a supplier row (supplier-toggle-N) threw an uncaught runtime TypeError: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading preprocessor)' from date-fns format. Root cause: the .map callback used `it` as iterator name (line 271), which shadowed the imported `it` Italian locale from 'date-fns/locale' (line 18). The call `format(parseISO(it.client_date), 'd MMM', { locale: it })` therefore passed the item object (no preprocessor) as the locale, crashing the whole page whenever any supplier was expanded.
ui_bugs.status: FIXED by testing agent - renamed map iterator from `it` to `item` throughout the inner map so the date-fns locale import remains reachable.

action_items: Review the Fornitori.jsx fix (map iterator rename `it` -> `item`) applied by the testing agent. Consider adding an ESLint rule (no-shadow) to prevent this class of bug in future.
critical_code_review_comments: Fornitori.jsx: variable-shadowing bug fixed. Recommend enabling eslint `no-shadow` and `no-shadow-restricted-names` at least for imported identifiers to catch these at build time.
server.py suppliers_summary endpoint (lines 1007-1097) is clean, correctly excludes MongoDB _id, uses async/await, returns Pydantic-serializable dict. No issues.
Suppliers list sort key `(name == 'Senza fornitore', -total)` correctly pins the no-supplier bucket last while primary sort is by total desc — verified by test_no_supplier_always_last.

Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY env vars set (they are NOT auto-loaded from frontend/.env by pytest). Frontend crash on supplier expansion has been fixed; verify main agent kept the rename `it` -> `item` in the inner .map of Fornitori.jsx.
rca of the issue: RCA: JavaScript lexical scoping — inner `.map((it, j) => ...)` shadowed the module-level `import { it } from 'date-fns/locale'`. Inside the callback, `it` resolves to the current material item, not the locale, so `format(..., { locale: it })` handed date-fns a plain object with no `.preprocessor` property, throwing a TypeError inside the locale format helper and crashing the whole React subtree. Reproduction: open /fornitori for a month with at least one material and click any supplier toggle. Mitigation: rename inner iterator to `item` (applied). Long-term: enable ESLint `no-shadow` on imports.
